skill.author: 0nl1n1n

security_audit.summary: All 249 static findings were adjudicated as false positives. The lockfile URLs and high-entropy strings are standard npm metadata and integrity checksums, while README and SKILL.md matches are documentation or Markdown examples. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, hidden file access, shell execution, or malicious intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The skill requests a SitemapKit API key and sends user-supplied site URLs to an external SitemapKit MCP service.
remediation.suggestion: Document the external service data flow and advise users to crawl only websites they are authorized to inspect.

remediation.issue: Examples encourage complete URL discovery, which can return large public URL lists.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the existing URL limits and truncation notices, and request a higher limit only when the user explicitly asks.

content.value_statement: Finding all public pages on a website can require checking several sitemap sources. SitemapKit discovers sitemap files and extracts their URLs through MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Find sitemap files through robots.txt, common locations, and sitemap indexes.
Extract URLs from a specific public sitemap URL.
Collect URLs across discovered sitemaps with one full crawl request.
Report URL counts and identify truncated results.
Surface remaining service quota from tool responses.
limitations: Requires the SitemapKit MCP server and a valid SitemapKit API key.
Only discovers URLs exposed through public sitemaps and related sitemap sources.
Results can be limited by the selected SitemapKit plan and quota.
The skill does not verify page content, page availability, or ownership authorization.

use_cases.title: Map a public site structure
use_cases.description: Discover sitemap files and page URLs before planning content, migration, or SEO work.

use_cases.title: Review migration coverage
use_cases.description: Compare sitemap URL lists to identify public routes that need migration planning.

use_cases.title: Research competitor navigation
use_cases.description: Review publicly indexed sitemap URLs to understand a website information structure.

prompt_templates.title: Find sitemaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Find all public sitemaps for https://example.com and list where each sitemap was discovered.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a sitemap
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract URLs from https://example.com/sitemap.xml. Include last modified dates when available.

prompt_templates.title: Count site pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the public URL list for https://example.com. Report the total count and say whether the result was truncated.

prompt_templates.title: Create a focused sitemap report
prompt_templates.prompt: Discover all sitemaps for https://example.com, collect up to 2000 URLs, group them by path prefix, and identify truncated results or quota limits.

output_examples.input: Find all public sitemaps for https://example.com.
output: Each sitemap URL is listed with its discovery source.

output_examples.input: How many public pages does https://example.com have?
output: The response includes the remaining monthly quota.

best_practices: Use full HTTPS URLs and choose the tool that matches the requested sitemap task.
Crawl only websites you are authorized to inspect and treat URL lists as public metadata.
Check truncation and remaining quota before requesting larger URL lists.
anti_patterns: Do not use a domain path with discovery tools when only the domain is evaluated.
Do not assume a sitemap contains every page or proves that a page is accessible.
Do not request a larger URL limit unless the user needs a more complete result.

faq.question: What does SitemapKit discover?
faq.answer: It finds public sitemap files and extracts URLs listed in them.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The SitemapKit MCP server requires a valid SitemapKit API key.

faq.question: Which tool should I use first?
faq.answer: Use discover_sitemaps when you need to find sitemap files for a domain.

faq.question: Can I extract one sitemap directly?
faq.answer: Yes. Use extract_sitemap with the exact public sitemap URL.

faq.question: Why is my result truncated?
faq.answer: The response exceeded the selected URL limit. Request a higher limit if your plan allows it.

faq.question: Does it crawl every accessible page?
faq.answer: No. It returns URLs exposed through public sitemap sources, not every reachable page.
